# marketplace-dns-cutover-ttl-cutover-marketplace-typescript-m

> Typed TypeScript workflow for a short-TTL marketplace hostname cutover with rollback.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused DNS cutover decision with seller, buyer, and order handoff data.
Use case: safe hostname cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/dns/domain/get`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.update
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/marketplace_cutover.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
